lesson-intro.text: Three plants from this path now share one sunny ledge: a cactus, a tulip and a bonsai, each in its own pot. Watch the pots line up, then start your garden.

ledge.text: Everything stands on a ledge. Draw a long, flat box across the lower part of your page.

pots.text: Three pots stand on it. Each is two lines leaning in toward the ledge. Make the right one low and wide.

rims.text: Give every pot a rim: a thin box lying across the top of its two sides.

cactus.text: A cactus grows in the left pot: a round-topped post, two L arms, and three dashes for spines.

tulip.text: In the middle pot, a tall stem with a three-point cup on top, then a leaf up each side.

bonsai.text: The last pot holds a bonsai. Wiggle its trunk up like a letter S, add a branch, and cap each end with a dome.

green.text: Color the cactus post, the tulip stem and the big bonsai dome green.

greens.text: Dark green for the tulip leaves and the small dome. Light green for the cactus arms.

pink-brown.text: Color the tulip pink. Brown is for the bonsai trunk and the first pot's rim.

orange-yellow.text: Orange for the first pot and the middle pot's rim. Yellow for the middle pot.

blue-purple.text: The bonsai pot is blue with a purple rim.

lesson-outro.text: Your windowsill is full, and so is the Plants path. Everything on that ledge was grown by you.
